about.title: About
about.intro: Dr. Elif Demir Uğur (EDU) is a scholar, Master Certified Coach (MCC), people & culture leader, and mythological novelist.
about.titles: Ph.D., MBA, MSc · MCC, ORSCC, NLP
about.bio: Over twenty-six years she has braided education, human resources, coaching, and mentoring. Co-founder of Thorius Eğitim ve Danışmanlık; founded and led Coaching & Mentoring at FLO Group; mentors STEM-graduate young women with UNDP; leads projects at ICF Turkey and founded the ICF Running Team. She is a senior executive who completed CHRO training at BMI Business School. Years as a mathematics teacher (MEF International, Avrupa Koleji, Kültür Koleji, MoNE) shaped her academic and pedagogical foundation.
about.langs: Turkish (native) · English (professional) · French, German, Italian, Spanish
about.volunteer: As founder and project leader of the ICF Running Team, she organized charity runs for children’s education; provided volunteer coaching for TEGV and ÖRAV teachers; and supported TEMA nature projects.

coaching.title: Executive Coaching
coaching.description: I bring together more than twenty-six years of experience in education, human resources, and coaching with the ICF Master Certified Coach (MCC) and ORSCC credentials. I accompany senior leaders as they clarify their own voice, find direction, and take sustainable steps.
coaching.eyebrow: ICF MCC · ORSCC · 26+ Years of Experience
coaching.intro: I bring together more than twenty-six years of experience in education, human resources, and coaching with the ICF Master Certified Coach (MCC) and ORSCC credentials. I accompany senior leaders as they clarify their own voice, find direction, and take sustainable steps.
credentials: CHRO Program · Built Corporate Coaching Structures
coaching.whoBody: I work one-on-one with senior executives, people and culture leaders, and decision-makers. I built a Coaching & Mentoring structure from the ground up in corporate life; I focus on authentic leadership, culture architecture, and the human side of performance. The conversation creates space for leaders to hear their own inner voice beyond the title and build a more honest connection with their teams.
whoItems: Authentic leadership and clarity in decision-making
People & culture architecture, team climate, and communication
Executive transitions, role expansion, and sustainable performance
Leading a coaching culture and building mentoring systems
coaching.aiBody: I accompany leaders and teams as they adopt AI thoughtfully into their work and culture. The focus is not the technology itself, but the human side of transformation — ethical, practical use, and integration that never replaces human judgment.
aiItems: Integrating AI into leadership and learning
Safe, responsible, sustainable use in team culture
Decision-making and communication rhythms that keep human judgment central
Ethical boundaries, transparency, and a clear everyday framework

studentCoaching.title: Student Coaching
studentCoaching.description: The bond I have built with young people through my years as a mathematics teacher and as a UNDP STEM mentor forms the backbone of my student coaching. With students at every stage from primary school to doctorate, as well as early-career candidates.
studentCoaching.intro: The bond I have built with young people through my years as a mathematics teacher and as a UNDP STEM mentor forms the backbone of my student coaching. With students at every stage from primary school to doctorate, as well as early-career candidates, we work on learning discipline, self-confidence, choosing a direction, and academic-personal balance. The goal is not to raise grades; it is for students to recognize their own potential and own their path.
areas: Learning discipline, focus, and study rhythm
Self-confidence, motivation, and exam / performance anxiety
Choosing a direction, university, graduate school, and early-career steps
Mentoring support on the STEM and academic journey (including thesis and doctoral processes)

stages.title: Primary and high school (Mathematics and English support)
stages.body: We work on study habits, focus, exam anxiety, and self-confidence, in collaboration with parents.

stages.title: University (Mathematics, Statistics)
stages.body: Choosing a major and direction, academic motivation, balancing campus life with personal well-being, and early-career preparation.

stages.title: Master's and doctoral (Mathematics, Business, Marketing, HR, Statistics, Educational Sciences)
stages.body: The thesis process, academic productivity, the advisor relationship, and career paths inside and outside academia.

stages.title: Thesis preparation support (especially statistical analyses and surveys)
stages.body: We work on statistical analyses, survey design, data interpretation, focus group work, and presentations throughout the thesis process.

books.title: Books
books.seriesIntro: A novel series woven from mythology, love, and ancient language.
books.auroraTitle: Aurora — A Mythology of Skyborne Love
books.auroraSubtitle: Fire and Air · The Mythology of Liberating Love
books.auroraBlurb: The sky caught fire once. Every star you see is the memory of an ember that burned. On one side, Odâra — flame returning from ash; on the other, Yelvân — the horizon that sets free. When the two met, the light people later called Aurora lit the heavens for the first time. But every light is followed by a shadow: the devouring pit Obrân, stolen embers, a will put to the test… A world where love grows not by possession, but by opening a horizon before the one you love. Speaking its own mythology and its own tongue, this novel asks what loving truly means: the beloved is not a destination, but a horizon that carries you to the light within — and from there, to the sky. Carrying the finesse of ancient wisdom into a modern narrative, Aurora is the first link in the seven-book Ancient Language Myths series. For those who listen to the sky.
books.auroraQuote: If you are the one who makes the light, no one can put it out.
books.auroraAccess: A journey that begins with a language forgotten and continues with an awakening — now reachable from anywhere in the world.
